# Where do your Stripe subscribers actually leave?

> Free Stripe churn and cohort analyzer: drop in your Stripe subscriptions CSV and get MRR, new vs churned MRR, monthly churn and a cohort retention table. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
